LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingModel: Radiation sickness runs its real course
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingModelDesc: On by default: radiation is a dose the body slowly repairs, and a large dose brings early sickness, a spell of feeling well, then the illness, which care can see someone through. It takes Dubs Rimatomics' radiation for people in place of its own sickness. Off: Rimatomics' own radiation sickness, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingHarshnessDesc: How large a dose kills, and how much care helps. Realistic follows the medical sources.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessGentleDesc: Half of those dosed die at 6 Gy without care, 9 Gy with full care. No late effects.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessModerateDesc: Half die at 5 Gy without care, 7.5 Gy with full care. Late effects at half their real chance.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessRealisticDesc: Half die at 4 Gy without care, 6 Gy with full care, as the medical sources say. Late effects at their real chance.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessHarshDesc: Half die at 3.5 Gy without care, 5 Gy with full care. Late effects at their real chance.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingEstimate: A doctor estimates a dose until it can be measured
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingEstimateDesc: On by default: until Dubs Rimatomics' portable radiation detectors are researched (or without Rimatomics), a dose shows only as a doctor's estimate, from how soon the person vomited, and closer after two days in a hospital bed. Off: every dose shows exactly.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_TipExact: Dose now: {EFFECTIVE} Gy after repair; {LIFETIME} Gy over a lifetime. Exposure category {CATEGORY}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_TipEstimate: A doctor's estimate: about {LOW} to {HIGH} Gy. Exposure category {CATEGORY}, if the estimate is right.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_TipUnknown: Exposed to radiation; how much is not known without a radiation counter. Exposure category {CATEGORY}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingLateHeading: Late effects, months or years after a dose (strength set by the harshness above)
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingCancerDesc: On by default: each gray a person takes over their life adds a chance of cancer later: leukaemia from about a month after the dose, other cancers from about two and a half game years. The chance is 5.5% a gray at full strength.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingCataractDesc: On by default: from half a gray, a chance of cataracts in both eyes later, certain at 5 Gy; the larger the dose, the sooner.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingSterilityDesc: On by default: a man becomes sterile for a while from 0.15 Gy, longer the larger the dose, and for good from about 3.5 to 6 Gy; a woman for good from about 2.5 to 6 Gy, less the older she is.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingPregnancyLossDesc: On by default: from 0.1 Gy in the first two weeks, or from half a gray later, a pregnancy may be lost.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingPregnancyChild: Harm to a child before birth
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingPregnancyChildDes: On by default: a dose in pregnancy may leave the child with weaker movement and hands (weeks 3 to 7) or slower learning and thinking (weeks 8 to 25, most of all 8 to 15).
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingPregnancyCancerDe: On by default: a child is born carrying the dose it took before birth, which adds to its own chance of cancer later.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_LetterLossText: {PAWN_labelShort} has lost {PAWN_possessive} pregnancy. The radiation {PAWN_pronoun} took reached the child.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_MessageLate: {PAWN_labelShort} has developed {CONDITION}, long after taking radiation.
